title: Artemis II: A new space race to the moon?
summary: 🚀 🌕 After months of delay, the #ArtemisII mission is set to take to the skies for a lunar flyby on Wednesday. Though the short-term goal is to bring humankind back to the #moon, there's a lot more at stake behind the scenes. FRANCE 24's Tanishk Saha explains ▶️ #NASA #Space #Artemis
